# Comparison / choice

**Status:** Accepted category; individual layouts and implementation details remain exploratory. Planning only, not a committed feature list.

## Candidate layouts

Two options, compact comparison matrix, pros/cons, before-and-after.

## Core information

Alternatives, shared criteria, comparable values.

## Category notes

**Comparison is accepted as its own category:** use side-by-side or split-screen views with aligned criteria, units, and context to support like-for-like comparison. The subject can vary; do not assume a specific domain or silently equate unlike quantities.

See the [template index](README.md) for shared planning boundaries and related categories.
